name: Thyatira
overview: Thyatira is notably recognized as the hometown of Lydia, a God-worshipping woman whose heart the Lord opened to respond to Paul’s message, highlighting the city’s role in the early spread of the gospel (Acts 16:14). In the book of Revelation, Thyatira is one of the seven churches addressed directly by the Son of God, who calls believers there to remain faithful and avoid false doctrines, emphasizing both the spiritual vigilance and encouragement given to this community (Revelation 1:11; 2:18, 24). This dual witness underscores Thyatira’s significance as a center of early Christian witness and the challenges faced in maintaining doctrinal purity.
